title: fix(pm): the regeneration carry lists a renamed path by both sides, not its destination alone
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi91bnws1UqmPVLyN8RpkkrJg)_

Fixes #33578

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：已留档的合同复审记录被「纯再生成/纯文案」跳转带到新 head 时，判定用的路径清单改为不做改名合并（`--no-renames`），改名同时列出源路径和目的路径。
- 为什么改：原来改名只列目的路径，把受审文件挪进文档目录（如 `skills/a/rules/security.md` → `content/docs/security.md`）只会看到文档路径，旧记录会被错误地延续到新 head。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `scripts/pm/` 内部工具与其自测，不发布任何包；回滚即还原本 PR 的提交。
- 先看：`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `CARRY_DIFF_ARGV` 与 `unexplainedPathsBetween`；同文件新增的真 git 自测行；`check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` 假 git 一行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test`，预期 401 例全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (carry region): `unexplainedPathsBetween` lists a hop's paths, and the pull request's own delta at each head, through one module-private argv, `CARRY_DIFF_ARGV = ['diff', '-z', '--name-only', '--no-renames']`. Both reads go through the one `names` helper, so the flag is spelled once. A rename now reads as a delete plus an add, so the source path is judged by the prose arm, the `merge=os-regen` attribute and the own-delta arm like any other path.
- Same file, self-test: the regen battery's fake git answers only that exact argv (any other spelling answers no paths), the two existing argument pins now spell `--no-renames`, and two cases are added (battery floor 22 → 24):
  - an argument pin: every `diff` the carry sent is `diff -z --name-only --no-renames A B`;
  - a REAL-git row in a temp repository: `skills/a/rules/security.md` moved to `content/docs/security.md`; a plain rename-detecting diff lists only the destination (the blind spot, measured in the same row), and `unexplainedPathsBetween` lists `skills/a/rules/security.md`. The row runs with `GIT_*` stripped (`gitFreeEnv`), `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1`, `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null`, and `-c` identity, `commit.gpgsign=false` and `diff.renames=true`, so it reads the same on any machine.
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (claim amendment 6897818459, one line): the regen battery's fake git took the revs positionally (`[, , , a, b]`), so the new argv read `--no-renames` as rev A and four guard cases went red. It now takes the two revs from the tail of argv. **Forced test edit.**
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` (claim amendment 6897818459, card comment 6887759291): the older real-git self-test fixtures (the real prober, the derive, size, oversized-sweep, rename-size and banner fixtures, and the argv-root `init`/`remote add`) now pass `env: gitFreeEnv()`; the three backdated-commit spawns spread `gitFreeEnv()` under their `GIT_*_DATE` keys. All of them already passed `-c commit.gpgsign=false`; the argv-root `init`/`remote add` make no commit. **Forced test edit** (hygiene, no behaviour change).

## Why

A carried contract-review record re-runs `unexplainedPathsBetween` on the committed trees of each `Regen-provenance:` hop. With git's default rename detection, `git diff --name-only` lists a rename by its destination alone. A hop that moved a reviewed file onto a prose face listed only the prose path, the prose arm explained it, and the record carried to a head where a reviewed file had left its face. The own-delta read had the same blind spot. The queue guard's own row enumeration and its low-risk carry check already pass `--no-renames`; this brings the carry reader in line.

## Tests

<details><summary>record-recognisers self-test (head 6c6a5c9e, after merging main)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `✓ record-recognisers self-test: 401 cases pass` (the two new cases on top of main e71ecc1b's set; 402 on the pre-merge head 80fb5317, whose base was c3c0c30d).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: drop the no-renames flag (heads 80fb5317 and 6c6a5c9e)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --anchor "Object.freeze(['diff', '-z', '--name-only', '--no-renames'])" --replacement "Object.freeze(['diff', '-z', '--name-only'])" -- node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test`

- 80fb5317: `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob d15231d06d0f -> 9da9b7818a7d`, exit 1, `4 of 402 case(s) failed`.
- 6c6a5c9e (after the merge): `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 03ae3466af62 -> 4352da5184ff`, exit 1, `4 of 401 case(s) failed`.
- Both times the four reds are: the real-git row (`{"destinationOnly":["content/docs/security.md"],"unexplained":[]}`), the new argument pin, and the two existing argv pins.
- Restore: `git diff HEAD` empty and the file's hash equals its HEAD blob.

</details>

<details><summary>Queue guard self-test</summary>

`node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`: with the carry change alone (head 0f2341bf) exit 1, 4 of 534 failed (the regen battery's slipped-in, names-the-path, hand-resolved and prose-and-code cases). With the tail-reading fake: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>check-governed-merges self-test under a hook-shaped environment</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test` → exit 0.
- `GIT_INDEX_FILE=SCRATCH/probe.index node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, no index file written.
- Control, the base file under the same environment → exit 1, 4 failures (the oversized-sweep and banner fixtures could not commit, and the INCOMPLETE-banner battery fell below its floor), and the outside index file was written.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The `check-governed-merges` self-test also spawns its own CLI (`spawnSync(process.execPath, [scriptPath, …])`) with `process.env`-based environments, and that child runs real git in the fixture roots. Those spawns were left as they are: the amendment scopes this PR to the fixtures' own git calls. carrier: #34066.
- Merged `origin/main` (e71ecc1b) as a merge commit: the one conflict was the adjacent `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` rows, resolved keeping both floors (this PR's regen battery 24, main's template battery 32). The delta against main is unchanged, +67 / -17 over the three files.
- On the first gate round, `check:pm-dispatch-gates` went red because the header export list grew by one line and moved the `self-test-reads` marker off the line its census pins (`record-recognisers.mjs:77`). The argv is now module-private and the header is unchanged; the marker is back on line 77.

## Verification

Local gate round on head `6c6a5c9e` (the merge of main, after the last commit): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 36 commands from the three `scripts/pm/` paths; all 36 ran, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `36 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. `check:pm-dispatch-gates` fast tier: `2205 cases pass; 9 slow section(s) deferred`. The same 36 were green on the pre-merge head `80fb5317`. Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI)
